items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Remote (U.S.) Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. Discord seeks a seasoned Data Engineer, focusing on our advertising product data. In this role, you will drive technical vision and strategy for ads data engineering in support of our ML initiatives while building and maintaining sophisticated data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools. You will lead cross-functional initiatives to transform our advertising products through data-driven insights and mentor fellow engineers to deliver exceptional results. This role works heavily with Data Science, Machine Learning, and product. If leading technical innovation, architecting scalable solutions, and empowering teams through data excites you, we encourage you to make a move! What You'll Be Doing Design and own core ads data models : fact/dim tables, canonical datasets, and aggregation layers that power delivery, measurement, targeting, attribution, and ML use cases. Build and maintain the ML data that enables ads ranking, delivery, and targeting - including feature development, label generation workflows, intra-day training, and ML input observability to catch data quality issues before they degrade model performance. Build conversion measurement pipelines and integrate third-party attribution data - including Conversion Attribution and Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrations (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Singular) - ensuring attribution accuracy and data parity across measurement surfaces. Build batch and near real-time pipeline infrastructure across the ads ecosystem - pushing toward lower-latency data for ML and reporting use cases on our BigQuery + dbt + Dagster stack. Partnering with Data Platform on launch and success of new data processing engines to support low latency requirements.. Develop data quality frameworks, monitoring systems, automated anomaly detection, and SLA infrastructure for critical ads pipelines at massive scale. Proactively identify foundational data infrastructure gaps - including those with broad implications across ML, measurement, and reporting - and design scalable, canonical solutions that multiple teams can depend on. Build systems from scratch in a rapidly evolving, greenfield advertising data environment - making sound architectural decisions with incomplete information and balancing short-term delivery with long-term infrastructure investment. Drive alignment across Data Science, ML Engineering, Ads Product, and GTM teams through clear narratives that connect data infrastructure decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact. Mentor engineers through technical challenges, code and design reviews, and ownership of complex projects - contributing to the culture and engineering standards of the Data Engineering team team. What you should have 5+ years of hands-on experience writing production code and architecting data pipelines with high-volume consumer data in advertising technology domains (ad delivery, ranking, targeting, identity, conversion measurement). Deep expertise in digital advertising data engineering - specifically in ads delivery, conversion measurement, attribution pipelines, or ML feature data infrastructure. Experience with Conversion Data and APIs, MMP integrations, or identity graph infrastructure is strongly valued. Demonstrated experience building data models in a greenfield or 0-to-1 environment where requirements change frequently, documentation is sparse, and architectural decisions are made with incomplete information. Expert-level SQL and Python . Strong ability to design performant, maintainable data models and write production-quality pipeline code. Proven hands-on experience with data quality audits, monitoring systems, and automated anomaly detection for massive-scale datasets (billions+ rows) - including quality frameworks designed for ML inputs. Strong technical communication skills with the ability to drive alignment, influence prioritization, and earn adoption from technical stakeholders. Collaborative mindset and strong cross-functional instincts with experience building trusted working relationships with Data Science, ML Engineering, and Product teams. Bonus Points Passion for Discord or gaming communities Experience with data visualization and dashboarding technologies (Looker, Tableau, or similar) Experience with designing data architecture to power a variety of use cases, including reporting (internal and external), adhoc analysis, experimentation. Working with Data AI tools to establish greater self service utility for your customers. Experience building near real-time or streaming pipeline infrastructure (e.g., Kafka, Spark Streaming, or equivalent) in addition to batch processing is preferred. The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Base Salary $196,000 — $245,000 USD Why Discord? Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/discord-senior-data-engineer-ads

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of member
items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work About You You likely have: A Bachelor's Degree Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments Experience in a high-growth environment Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred) Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations Why This Role Matters Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust. Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Performance Task — 60 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/carrot-business-intelligence-analyst

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Poland At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization. As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure. What you'll do Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows) Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue. What we look for 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake) Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Total rewards We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future. In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits. Base Pay Grade - K 226 000 zł - 346 000 zł Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills. In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially. Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars) Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example Equity grade: 2 New hire equity: $16,000-$24,000 Annual Refresh: $5,000 Reward equity: $0-$75,000 Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month. In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include: Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge. Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package. A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being. Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally. Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly. Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members. Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion. Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy. Location - Remote Poland The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland. **This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.** #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/affirm-analytics-engineer-ii-full-stack-revenue-analytics

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - United States Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base. Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas. Responsibilities: Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives. Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines. Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability. Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment. Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc. Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data. Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering. Experience in data analysis and dashboard design. Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases. Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. Agentic AI-assisted development experience. Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen. Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team. Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/ Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave #LI-Remote Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $164,200 — $229,990 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-analytics-engineer

This is a high-impact role where youâll help safeguard the business by developing risk frameworks, analyzing emerging threats, strengthening internal controls, and delivering actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. Translate technical risk findings into clear business insights. Maintain accurate documentation for executive reporting and audit purposes. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with: Finance Operations Compliance Legal IT & Security Executive Leadership Embed risk awareness into business processes. Support continuous improvement of enterprise risk management frameworks. RequirementsMust-Have QualificationsExperience 3+ years of experience in: Risk Management Enterprise Risk Compliance Audit Governance Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments. Core Skills Strong proficiency in: SQL Microsoft Excel Data analysis Experience using Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms such as: Archer ServiceNow LogicManager Or similar solutions Strong understanding of: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Internal controls Regulatory compliance Experience creating executive dashboards and risk reports. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Nice to Have Professional certifications such as: FRM CFA CPA CCEP Experience with: VaR Monte Carlo simulations Stress testing Background in: Financial Services Healthcare SaaS Enterprise Technology Experience supporting board reporting or executive governance committees. Knowledge of: Cyber risk Vendor risk Operational resilience Experience using: Tableau Power BI Looker What Makes You a Strong Fit Strong analytical and quantitative mindset. Exceptional attention to detail. Able to simplify complex risk concepts for business stakeholders. Proactive in identifying issues before they become significant risks. Strong balance of technical expertise and business judgment. Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Tools & Technologies SQL Microsoft Excel Python R SAS Power BI Tableau Looker Archer ServiceNow LogicManager Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) platforms What a Typical Day Looks Like Review dashboards for emerging operational, financial, or compliance risks. Run quantitative risk analyses and stress tests. Update risk registers and remediation trackers. Test internal controls and validate governance processes. Prepare executive reports and compliance documentation. Collaborate with business teams to strengthen risk mitigation strategies. Track remediation progress and regulatory deadlines. In short: You serve as the organizationâs early-warning systemâidentifying, assessing, and mitigating risks before they impact the business. Key Metrics for Success (KPIs) Timely and accurate risk reporting. Internal controls tested and validated on schedule. Early identification and mitigation of business risks. Zero missed regulatory or audit deadlines. High-quality executive reporting and dashboards. Positive audit outcomes and leadership confidence. Why Join Us? Make a direct impact on enterprise risk strategy. Work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams. Influence governance, compliance, and operational resilience. Build scalable risk management frameworks. Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities. Clear career progression into: Senior Risk Manager Enterprise Risk Lead Director of Risk & Compliance Chief Risk Officer (CRO) Interview Process Application Review Spark Hire Intro Video (3â5 minutes) Recruiter Interview Practical Assessment (Risk Analysis & Recommendations) Client Interview Offer & Background Verification What Happens After You Apply Right after you apply, youâll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever itâs convenient for you. Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, youâll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds. Donât overthink itâyou can record your video as many times as youâd like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application. Apply Now If youâre a Risk Analyst or Risk Manager who enjoys identifying business risks, strengthening governance, improving compliance, and helping organizations make informed decisions, weâd love to hear from you. Apply today and play a key role in protecting and strengthening a growing business. Please mention the word **IMPRESSIVENESS** and tag RNC4yNDIuMTk2LjE1MA== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNC4yNDIuMTk2LjE1MA==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of member
items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Sr. Manager, Data Engineering to lead our Business Intelligence data engineering function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is a senior player/coach role with a strong emphasis on strategic leadership, technical excellence, and organizational impact. You will lead and grow a high-impact team while remaining deeply hands-on in architecting and building Carrot's data infrastructure. You will set technical vision, drive cross-functional data strategy, and ensure our data systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. You will influence and execute on the long-term roadmap for Data Engineering within the Data Team, defining how we ingest, transform, govern, and expose data across the company, and partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, and Go-To-Market functions. Given the small-but-mighty nature of the team, this role requires someone who is comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: setting multi-year architectural direction, shaping team and org design, and still rolling up their sleeves to build production-grade pipelines when needed. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Own the technical vision and roadmap for BI data engineering, aligning it with company strategy and analytics needs. Design, build, and review scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and workflow orchestration systems, contributing hands-on production code in Python and SQL . Architect and optimize data warehouse models that support advanced analytics, self-service BI, and operational reporting. Establish and enforce standards for reliability, observability, testing, and performance across all data systems. Drive improvements in data quality, lineage, and governance , including documentation and metadata practices. Partner with backend product engineering teams to co-design production database schemas and event models with analytics and reporting in mind. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers , fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration. Own team-level planning and execution , including capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery across concurrent workstreams. Translate ambiguous business and analytics needs into a clear, prioritized engineering roadmap with measurable outcomes. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Security, and Legal to align on priorities, ensure compliance, and remove cross-functional blockers. Evaluate and influence build vs. buy decisions , vendor selection, and tool adoption across data platforms, ingestion, and transformation. What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Elevated the maturity and consistency of data engineering practices across the BI function, with clear standards for reliability, testing, and observability. Built and retained a high-performing data engineering team recognized as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the business. Delivered a prioritized data engineering roadmap aligned with company strategy, with measurable progress on scalability and platform modernization. Strengthened the accuracy, recency, and security of enterprise data, meeting the requirements of regulated healthcare contexts. Enabled advanced analytics, self-service BI, and data products that drive meaningful business outcomes and influence Carrot's long-term data architecture strategy. About You You likely have: 8-10+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, including 3-5+ years leading and managing data or software engineers. 5+ years of advanced SQL and 5+ years of Python development experience in production environments, including unit and integration testing. Strong, hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines in production. Proficiency with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and modern ingestion, transformation, and orchestration tools (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, Airflow). Strong understanding of relational modeling and warehouse design principles , plus version control (Git preferred) and modern CI/CD practices. Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy and standards while remaining capable of direct technical execution. Excellent written and verbal communication skills , with strong knowledge of data governance, security best practices, and compliance protocols. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Direct experience with Carrot's current tech stack : Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, and AWS. Experience with enterprise BI platforms and enabling self-service analytics. Experience integrating batch and event-streaming or real-time ingestion systems . Prior experience leading data engineering teams in a startup or high-growth environment , ideally including managing other leads or senior-level ICs. Healthcare industry experience , including familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) and privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR). Why This Role Matters The reliability, scalability, and usability of Carrot's data systems directly power decision-making across the organization and for our clients. Data Engineering plays a foundational role in enabling the broader Business Intelligence function, and this role serves as the senior-most manager directly responsible for that capability. The Business Intelligence team at Carrot is highly cross-functional and central to the company's long-term success. Led by our Vice President of Data and Business Intelligence, the team includes data engineers, data scientists, and business intelligence analysts. In this role, you will build and nurture a high-performing team, ensure the accuracy and security of enterprise data in a regulated healthcare context, and influence the long-term data architecture and platform strategy at Carrot. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation: Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $170,000-$210,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/carrot-sr-manager-data-engineering

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: Remote-US ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast. We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Principal Data Engineer to define and evolve the architecture, engineering standards, and operating model for our enterprise data platform. This role is for a technical leader who excels at complex system design: translating business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable data products. The Principal Data Engineer will lead critical architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, transformation, orchestration, governance, observability, and consumption, while raising the engineering bar through mentorship, design reviews, and pragmatic best practices. You will work across engineering, analytics, platform, security, and business stakeholders to create systems that make trusted data accessible, timely, and actionable at scale. What You’ll Do Lead Data Architecture and System Design Own the technical vision and architecture for scalable, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms and pipelines. Design end-to-end data systems spanning batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, data modeling, storage, orchestration, serving layers, and consumption patterns. Make and document high-quality architecture decisions, including tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, scalability, latency, security, maintainability, and cost. Define reusable architectural patterns for common data engineering challenges, including CDC, event-driven data flows, schema evolution, slowly changing dimensions, data quality, and multi-tenant or domain-oriented data models. Establish clear boundaries and interfaces between operational systems, data platforms, analytics layers, and downstream applications. Lead technical design reviews for high-impact initiatives and provide clear, constructive direction on implementation approaches. Identify architectural risks early and drive plans to mitigate technical debt, single points of failure, data inconsistency, and operational fragility. Set Engineering Standards and Best Practices Establish and continuously improve standards for data engineering development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and lifecycle management. Define best practices for version-controlled data transformations, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, and environment promotion. Build a culture of data reliability by implementing standards for data contracts, schema management, lineage, observability, freshness, completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation. Champion security, privacy, access control, governance, retention, and compliance requirements throughout the data lifecycle. Develop practical engineering guardrails that enable teams to move quickly without sacrificing quality, trust, or operational excellence. Drive adoption of well-defined SLIs, SLOs, alerting, runbooks, and post-incident learning practices for critical data products. Drive Technical Decision-Making Serve as a trusted technical authority for complex, cross-functional decisions involving data architecture, tooling, platform capabilities, and engineering investments. Facilitate technical discussions that turn ambiguous requirements into durable, well-reasoned solutions. Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, platform technologies, and vendor capabilities using clear criteria and documented recommendations. Align architecture decisions with organizational priorities, business outcomes, data strategy, and long-term platform sustainability. Create and maintain architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and technical standards that provide clarity across teams. Influence leaders and stakeholders through concise communication of technical options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward. Build and Improve Data Products Lead the design and development of high-value, production-grade data pipelines, datasets, and platform capabilities. Partner with data analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to deliver well-modeled, discoverable, and trustworthy data products. Optimize data systems for reliability, usability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Drive modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms, consolidation of fragmented pipelines, and reduction of manual operational processes. Ensure data products are designed with clear ownership, documentation, lineage, quality expectations, and support models. Mentor and Multiply Engineering Excellence Mentor data engineers at all levels, with a particular focus on growing senior engineers into strong technical leaders. Provide practical coaching on system design, data modeling, debugging, performance tuning, code quality, and production operations. Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, design sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums. Establish reusable templates, reference implementations, and playbooks that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. Foster an inclusive, high-accountability engineering culture centered on thoughtful collaboration, continuous learning, and ownership. Act as a technical multiplier: helping teams make better decisions independently while maintaining alignment with shared architectural principles. What you bring Required 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years designing and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed data systems, or enterprise-grade data products. Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end system design, including defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, designing resilient architectures, and delivering production systems. Deep experience with modern data architecture concepts, such as lakehouse or warehouse platforms, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, orchestration, metadata management, and data governance. Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or similar. Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent platforms. Strong knowledge of data modeling practices across analytical, operational, and domain-oriented use cases. Experience establishing engineering standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure as code, reliability, and security. Proven ability to lead technical decisions across multiple teams without relying on direct authority. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards across an organization. Preferred Experience with cloud-native data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience implementing data mesh, domain-oriented data product, or self-service platform patterns. Familiarity with data governance, cataloging, lineage, privacy, and access-control tooling. Experience supporting financial, revenue, operational, customer, or enterprise analytics domains. Experience with ML data pipelines, feature stores, or AI/LLM data foundations. Experience managing major data-platform migrations, modernization programs, or large-scale architectural transformations. Leadership Competencies Systems thinker : Connects individual technical decisions to broader platform, organizational, and business outcomes. Pragmatic architect : Balances ideal-state architecture with incremental delivery and operational realities. Technical judgment : Makes clear recommendations amid ambiguity and communicates tradeoffs transparently. Builder and operator : Designs for production from the beginning, including reliability, security, observability, and supportability. Mentor and multiplier : Develops others and creates scalable mechanisms for technical excellence. Collaborative influencer : Builds alignment across engineering, analytics, security, product, and business teams. Our Technology Stack Languages & Databases: Python, SQL, MySQL, NoSQL databases Orchestration & Transformation: Airflow, dbt Data Platforms: Snowflake, AWS, GCP, BigQuery, Redshift Data Integration: Fivetran, custom ETL/ELT frameworks Observability & Data Reliability: Datadog, monitoring, alerting, data-quality frameworks #LI-JH1 #LI-Remote Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. items.description: Data and Analytics SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. GATEWAY FLEET SPECIALIST: Starlink is building the world’s largest fleet of satellite ground stations. These gateways are the critical link between our satellites and the global internet backbone, and their reliability directly determines the quality of service for millions of users. We are seeking fleet specialists to own the reliability, growth, and sustainment of our fleet of Gateway antennas and sites across a region of the world. This is a true owner-operator role, managing everything from technical troubleshooting and spare parts strategy to international logistics, contractor performance, and field execution. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building operational excellence in fast-moving and internationally complex environments. You must be equally comfortable managing heavy equipment deployments in remote locations as you are negotiating with customs authorities and coaching contractors toward higher performance standards. RESPONSIBILITIES: Own the maintenance, operations, health, and growth for our fleet of Starlink Gateway Antennas and Sites for a region of the world Manage spare parts strategy, inventory planning, and materials movement across the region, to maintain rapid response readiness for both planned and emergency maintenance Monitor fleet health using dashboards and telemetry data to identify issues, diagnose software and hardware failures, drive timely repairs, and identify emerging degradation trends. Partner with engineering teams to execute fleetwide campaigns and perform root cause analysis on antenna and site failures across electrical, fiber optic, radiofrequency, and mechanical systems Coordinate with logistics providers, customs authorities, and regional partners to ensure timely and compliant international shipping of critical parts and equipment Manage relationships with contracted labor in the region, including training and capability development Analyze operational data and field feedback to identify systemic pain points and drive improvements in processes and tools Share ownership of the team’s growth: work with engineers and specialists to build scalable organizational structures that can support the rapid expansion of the world’s largest fleet of satellite ground stations. Basic Qualifications: High school diploma or equivalency certificate 2+ years of experience operations, logistics, technical support, field service, data analytics, project management, or a similar role involving distributed assets PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 1+ years of experience in a customer support associate, technical support associate, quality specialist, process planner, business analyst, or leadership role Hands on experience with satellite ground stations, antennas; electrical, fiber optic, radiofrequency, or mechanical systems Experience supporting geographically distributed technical equipment or infrastructure Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL and/or other data visualization tools Background in root cause analysis and cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams Experience managing contractors or third-party vendors, particularly in international or remote environments Familiarity with MRP/ERP systems and spare parts/inventory management Proficiency in one or more of the following languages (in addition to English): Portuguese, French, Punjabi, Hindi, Japanese, Bengali, Kazakh, Arabic, Urdu, Vietnamese, Swahili, Sesotho, Swati, Tagalog. Knowledge of local business culture is a plus Experience troubleshooting or working with IT/network infrastructure (UPS, PDUs, servers, or networking equipment) Demonstrated ability to design efficient processes and systems, especially defining requirements for software tools Experience autonomously managing projects with minimal supervision ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Willing to travel 10-15% of the time Willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed Willing to work outside of normal business hours 20-40% if the time COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay Range: Level 1: $27.00 - $40.00 Level 2: $31.00 - $45.00 Level 3: $36.00 - $51.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday. ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to help operate, scale, and improve the data platforms that support Oportun’s analytics, engineering, and business teams. This role will focus on Databricks, AWS, data pipelines, databases, observability, automation, and production support. You’ll be responsible for keeping critical data-platform services reliable, secure, performant, and cost-effective while partnering closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Success in this role means improving platform reliability, reducing operational friction, strengthening automation, and helping teams resolve issues quickly and sustainably. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll administer and support Databricks workspaces, cluster policies, compute configurations, jobs, workflows, libraries, service principals, permissions, and platform integrations. You’ll support Unity Catalog, including access governance, catalog and schema permissions, and secure data sharing. You’ll monitor and troubleshoot Delta Live Tables, Spark jobs, Delta Lake workloads, and data pipelines, including failures, performance issues, recovery, and data-quality concerns. You’ll maintain secure and reliable integrations between Databricks and AWS services, including S3, IAM, networking, VPC connectivity, and external data sources. You’ll support AWS infrastructure used by the data platform, including EC2, VPC, IAM, security groups, networking, patching, and operational access. You’ll support MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB environments, including availability, monitoring, connectivity, backup coordination, performance troubleshooting, and recovery. You’ll build and maintain monitoring, dashboards, logs, metrics, and alerts across Databricks, pipelines, databases, infrastructure, and integrations. You’ll participate in on-call support and lead investigation, mitigation, recovery, communication, and root-cause analysis for production incidents. You’ll build and maintain infrastructure and automation using Terraform, Terraform Enterprise, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting. You’ll automate repeatable operational activities such as provisioning, access configuration, monitoring deployment, recovery, and platform changes. You’ll manage secure access controls, secrets, certificates, TLS configuration, service accounts, and IAM roles across platform services. You’ll improve operational readiness through runbooks, recovery procedures, architecture diagrams, standards, escalation paths, and technical documentation. You’ll partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to improve capacity planning, platform performance, cost visibility, and resource optimization. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve troubleshooting, documentation, incident response, and operational efficiency. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on platform engineer who enjoys solving complex production problems and improving the systems behind critical data workloads. You think beyond the immediate issue, look for root causes, and build solutions that make the platform more reliable and easier to operate. You’re comfortable working across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, databases, automation, and security. You communicate clearly during incidents, take ownership through resolution, and consistently look for ways to reduce repetitive work and improve operational maturity. What You Bring Skills & experience Required Strong experience supporting production data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DataOps environments. Hands-on experience administering and supporting Databricks, including workspaces, jobs, workflows, compute, cluster policies, and access controls. Experience supporting Spark, Delta Lake, and Delta Live Tables workloads. Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, security groups, CloudWatch, and networking. Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise or similar tools. Experience supporting MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB in production environments. Strong understanding of monitoring, observability, alerting, and incident-management practices. Experience with CI/CD, Git, GitHub Actions, and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages. Experience troubleshooting platform performance, connectivity, permissions, certificates, TLS, and integration issues. Experience with production support, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and on-call operations. Strong understanding of security and access concepts such as IAM, RBAC, secrets management, certificates, and secure connectivity. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Nice to Have Experience with Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Databricks CLI, REST APIs, and Databricks asset or deployment bundles. Experience with Kubernetes administration and production troubleshooting. Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms. Experience with Rootly or similar incident-management platforms. Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Ops Manager, or comparable MongoDB tooling. Experience with MariaDB/MySQL replication, schema migrations, indexing, backup validation, and restore procedures. Experience with capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and workload performance tuning. Experience implementing or improving data governance, compliance controls, or audit processes. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve operations, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund Life Insurance Internet and Electricity Allowance Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-dataops-engineer-r14334

items.description: Job Title: Human Data Manager Job Type: Full-time Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and manage robust data workflows for accurate annotation, collection, processing, and analysis. Establish and monitor KPIs to optimize operational performance and drive data-driven decision-making. Analyze datasets to uncover actionable insights and present recommendations that accelerate efficiency. Collaborate cross-functionally to align data strategies with overarching business objectives. Develop and maintain comprehensive reporting frameworks tracking key metrics and workflow improvements. Continuously refine processes to ensure scalability, maintain data integrity, and uphold quality standards. Demonstrate ownership and a proactive, hands-on approach to identifying and solving operational challenges. Required Skills and Qualifications Technical aptitude with demonstrated experience in data analysis, annotation, or workflow optimization. Familiarity with operational processes and a passion for increasing efficiency. Ability to interpret and communicate data-driven insights clearly and persuasively, both in writing and verbally. Strong drive to learn, thrive under pressure, and a willingness to work hard in a fast-paced environment. Excellent collaboration skills and attention to detail in managing data quality and validation. Preferred Qualifications Background in engineering or technical fields with operational focus or human data projects. Experience with data visualization tools (such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI) or programming languages (such as Python, SQL). Internship or project-based experience in data management, AI/ML, or process optimization. Regional Hiring Notes This role is being hired in parallel across multiple regions due to coverage needs, compliance requirements, and time-zone alignment. Responsibilities and expectations are identical; employment terms vary by region. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.) **This is a contract role expected to last until April 15th, 2027 Location : This role is Remote in the U.S., with the option to work onsite from our San Francisco, CA headquarters. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. About Doximity Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role As a Business Intelligence Analyst , you will: Work closely with our Product, Strategic Analytics, Client Success, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates. Continue to improve your technical and non-technical skill sets. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Grow into a presentation/communication-focused role or dive deeper into more-involved technical challenges—the choice is yours. What We're Looking For We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications: Must have: Three (3) years of experience illustrating collaboration, passion for data, reliability, precision, curiosity, and respect for teammates and clients. Excellent SQL skills with proven ability to create and evaluate complex SQL statements involving numerous tables and complex relationships. Fluent in Python and experience using common modules (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib) for EDA. Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Working knowledge of statistics and visualization. Experience working with data visualization tools. Advanced Excel skills. Experience using AI coding assistants and building AI-leveraged workflows. Experience working in the healthcare industry. Experience presenting data to a non-technical audience. The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Precision – Our team's deliverables power client analysis and inform real-world decisions. A successful candidate will triple check their work and their teammates' work, holding all of us to the highest data quality standards. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work. Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning. Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work. Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development. Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated. Our Hiring Process & AI Tools Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. Equal Employment Opportunity Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-business-intelligence-analyst-contractor
