items.title: Associate Data Scientist
items.summary: Description Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. Your models donât just sit on a shelf - they shape strategy, optimize efficiency, and fuel company growth. You thrive on uncovering hidden patterns, validating hypotheses, and embedding machine learning models into real-world AI applications. If that sounds like you - read on. AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results. This job will give you ALL the feels: At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density. The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal. This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦ Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions. Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities. Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis. A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood. Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics. A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization. A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point. An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability. Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI. Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you. Other Qualities Youâll Need At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities: Youâre humbleââyou put the team and othersâ needs ahead of your own Youâre hungry to learn more Youâre people smartââin the sense that youâre a great teammate The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you. What Will You Earn? We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that. Youâll also enjoy the following benefits: Monthly team events and activities Weekly team lunches Casual dress code Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain Remote working is okay with us too. And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too. How To Apply So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal? Job opportunities like this donât come along often, and weâve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Associate Data Scientist is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application: If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully: 1. Write a cover letter addressing: Why are you the best Associate Data Scientist for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements. Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view What's the toughest challenge youâve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it? What are the last three books youâve read? What do you do for fun? 2. Explain what youâre doing now for a job: If you donât have one, explain why. If you have one, explain why youâre looking elsewhere. 3. Upload your cover letter and resume Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file. Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but itâs our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops. Click the âApply Nowâ button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume. ***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!*** We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can also expect a prompt response. Please mention the word **EARNESTNESS** and tag RNC4yNDIuMTk2LjE1MA== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNC4yNDIuMTk2LjE1MA==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: Quantitative Rates Researcher
items.summary: Role Title: Quantitative Rates Researcher Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging Quantitative Rates Researchers to contribute to a leading investment bank’s algorithmic trading platform project.
items.description: Role Title: Quantitative Rates Researcher Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Quantitative Rates Researchers to contribute to a leading investment bank’s algorithmic trading platform project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Review and assess AI-generated quantitative research and trading strategy outputs focused on fixed income and rates markets Identify and document methodological issues such as lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions Evaluate the accuracy of backtesting frameworks, especially with respect to rates-specific mechanics like carry/roll-down and contract roll conventions Scrutinize the statistical rigor of signal construction, factor modeling, and alpha research in the provided outputs Deliver detailed written feedback on model assumptions, implementation fidelity, and research soundness Collaborate asynchronously with project coordinators by clarifying findings and suggestions through clear written and verbal communication Contribute to the refinement of research evaluation processes for greater accuracy and relevance Preferred Qualifications Background as a quantitative researcher, analyst, or consultant with expertise in fixed income or rates markets Demonstrated experience building and backtesting systematic rates strategies at a hedge fund, asset manager, or bank Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scipy) or R for quantitative research and data analysis Strong understanding of yield curve modeling, carry/roll-down analytics, relative value trading, SOFR/Eurodollar instruments, and Treasury futures Comfort evaluating research under real-world trading conditions, including transaction costs and liquidity constraints Exceptional attention to detail and ability to articulate complex quantitative findings in clear, concise written feedback Prior experience assessing or reviewing models for compliance with best practices in quantitative finance is a plus Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Physics Expert (PhD / Postdoc)
items.summary: Role Title: Physics Expert (PhD / Postdoc) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote (Worldwide) Schedule: 10-15+ hours a week, Fully Flexible (Can accommodate working after hours/weekends) micro1 is engaging Physics Experts (PhD / Postdoc) to contribute deep scientific knowledge and problem-solving skills to a high-impact customer project.
items.description: Role Title: Physics Expert (PhD / Postdoc) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote (Worldwide) Schedule: 10-15+ hours a week, Fully Flexible (Can accommodate working after hours/weekends) micro1 is engaging Physics Experts (PhD / Postdoc) to contribute deep scientific knowledge and problem-solving skills to a high-impact customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Solve advanced physics problems from your specialization, delivering rigorous, well-documented derivations and analyses. Produce technically precise, clearly written solutions, detailing all assumptions, approximations, and final results using LaTeX mathematical notation. Utilize SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for symbolic or numerical verification and clear computational workflows where relevant. Identify and articulate subtleties in problem statements, including special cases, boundary conditions, and dimensional consistency. Flag ambiguities in project materials, proposing well-reasoned interpretations and clarifications as needed. Iterate on submitted solutions in response to feedback from project reviewers, ensuring corrections are cleanly integrated. Uphold rigorous standards in documentation and reproducibility consistent with professional research practice. Preferred Qualifications PhD in physics or advanced-stage PhD candidacy, with active research experience in a relevant subfield. Research expertise in one or more of: High Energy Physics, Mathematical Physics, Biophysics, Statistical Physics, Condensed Matter (including moiré systems, magnetism, PXP/Rydberg), AMO/Quantum Optics, Gravitation, Cosmology, Astrophysics, Quantum Information, or Optical Properties of Materials. 2–5 recent representative publications (past ~5 years) in your field, with accessible arXiv or DOI records. Proficiency with LaTeX for presenting mathematics, and with SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for computational work; willingness to indicate areas for further support if needed. Demonstrated excellence in written technical communication, with a track record of producing clear, precise, and well-argued scientific outputs. Strong analytical skills, able to isolate key physical principles and provide nuanced solutions to complex problems. Availability to engage with the project consistently over an 8–10 week period (approx. 10 hours/week). Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Software Engineer - App Stores
items.summary: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Your future team As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Atlassian, you'll be at the forefront of applied AI, working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, AI-powered solutions. The FDE team partners with top organizations across industries, helping them leverage Atlassian's AI capabilities to solve complex, real-world problems. You'll collaborate with product, engineering, and design, rapidly growing your technical and domain expertise while making a tangible impact on business outcomes. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for those who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are passionate about shaping the future of AI-powered teamwork. What you'll do As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will: Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML-powered solutions tailored to customer needs. Architect and implement robust application integrations using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with a focus on APIs, microservices, and enterprise-scale systems. Drive data-driven solution development by analyzing complex datasets to extract insights and inform product direction. Champion the adoption of AI-augmented workflow automation within customer environments, maximizing business value and operational efficiency. Oversee the end-to-end deployment of AI solutions into production, ensuring continuous evaluation, monitoring, and improvement. Navigate risk and compliance requirements, including AI risk assessment, data privacy (GDPR), and regulatory frameworks. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, creating concise artifacts for peers, partners, and leadership. Align technical solutions with business objectives, setting a clear vision for technological progress and measurable results. At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. On the first day, we'll expect you to have: 10+ years of experience in backend software development. 5+ years of experience delivering impactful AI/ML solutions in production environments, including experience as a founding or forward-deployed engineer in 0-to-1 product development. Deep expertise in applied AI/ML, including generative AI, LLMs, and agent-based frameworks. Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, and experience with APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration. Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and thrive in rapidly changing environments. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority. Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR). Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals. It's great, but not required, if you have: Experience with Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo AI, or AI-powered Atlassian features. Familiarity with regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare). Experience deploying AI solutions to complex production systems at scale. Prior experience mentoring or leading engineering teams. Benefits & Perks Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . About Atlassian At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh . In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

items.description: Role Title: Applied Scientist Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Applied Scientists to contribute to a customer's data-driven project, focusing on advanced analytics and experimentation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required; your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is part of an open Data Scientist project, with a strong emphasis on clear written and verbal communication. Scope of Work Design and execute statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights from complex datasets. Develop and validate machine learning models for various business or research objectives. Apply data modeling techniques and manage large-scale data transformations using Python and Pandas. Collaborate with stakeholders to define experimentation frameworks and analyze outcomes. Document methodology, findings, and recommendations with a focus on clarity and precision. Review peer contributions and provide high-quality feedback to support knowledge sharing. Deliver reproducible code and well-organized analytical reports as part of the project deliverables. Evaluate AI model outputs on statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative problems. Create expert-level prompts, datasets, and reference solutions. Identify flawed methodology, statistical errors, and weak quantitative reasoning. Provide clear, structured feedback that improves model capability. Preferred Qualifications At least one year at a top company (tech, finance, or research). Expertise in Python, including proficiency with libraries such as Pandas and scikit-learn (sklearn). Demonstrated experience in applied statistics, experimental design, and machine learning. Proven ability to develop, tune, and evaluate machine learning models in practical settings. Strong data modeling skills and experience managing structured and unstructured data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a passion for clear technical documentation. Experience collaborating on open or cross-functional data science projects is a plus. Advanced academic background or hands-on work in data science, applied mathematics, or related fields. We're looking for someone excited to pitch the vision of Airtable, implement creative solutions and negotiation tactics that mitigate churn, and identify new and strategic opportunities at renewal time that drive expansion. As a Renewals Associate on our Sales team, you will be the architect of these conversations, and will collaborate with multiple internal stakeholders (Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Deal Desk, etc.) to help to ensure that our customers realize value, and are set up for longterm, sustained success with Airtable. What you'll do You will own, drive, and lead the renewals process in collaboration with the account team to preserve and enhance customer contracts and relationships You will be a primary stakeholder (along with XFN partners) in building the foundational processes and playbooks for this new role You will actively engage with key decision-makers to identify customer requirements and uncover roadblocks to ensure on-time commitments You will maintain and report an accurate rolling 90-day forecast of renewals in your territory You will negotiate and execute renewal contracts (in partnership with legal) that align to customer goals You will discover and identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities upon contract renewal to maximize customer growth Develop playbook for renewal engagement maximizing revenue retention Who you are 2+ years of quota-carrying Post-Sales / Customer Success / Account Management experience, preferably within an Enterprise SaaS organization Strong negotiation skills and demonstrated capability closing large, complex contracts Strong collaboration skills and successful experiences working with internal XFN partners (Rev Ops, Biz Tech) as well as customer facing counterparts (Sales & Success) Ability and eagerness to grow business in a strategic manner, i.e. creating new processes and initiatives Approaches work with empathy, craftsmanship, and a growth mindset - you are a self motivated and proactive team player Solid understanding of Enterprise SaaS applications and collaboration technology Consistent track record of achieving personal and team goals History of thriving in a rapidly changing environment What we offer Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. For work locations in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York, the on-target earnings range for this role is $98,000 - $127,700 USD. For all other work locations (including remote), the range is $88,000 - $115,400 USD. items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Fully Remote, Bulgaria URL: http://noviglobal.com Our client is a growing European IT services group bringing together established technology companies across Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Bulgaria. With a strong presence in the DACH market and a broad portfolio covering managed IT services, cloud, cybersecurity, digital transformation, and AI, the Group supports organisations across a wide range of industries with complex technology needs. As the group continues to grow and integrate new companies, it has reached a point where common systems, processes, and operational standards are needed to support the organisation as a whole. As part of this internal group-wide project , they are establishing a dedicated team responsible for integrating and harmonising business systems and data across the group, and are looking for a HubSpot CRM Administrator to join the team. This is a fully remote position based in Bulgaria , offering the opportunity to administer, configure and maintain HubSpot CRM as part of the group's ongoing integration activities. The role focuses on ensuring reliable system operation, maintaining data quality, managing complex CRM configurations and supporting integrations with other business systems, including Microsoft Dynamics 365. Develop, maintain and optimize HubSpot workflows, automation rules and lead management processes. Configure and maintain integrations between HubSpot and other business systems, ensuring reliable data synchronization and resolving integration issues. Support marketing automation activities, including campaign workflows, lead nurturing, segmentation and lead scoring. Monitor automation and campaign performance, identify potential issues and implement improvements. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate operational and marketing requirements into scalable CRM configurations and automated processes. Requirements: Hands-on experience administering, configuring and supporting HubSpot CRM, including workflows, properties, permissions and data management. Good understanding of CRM data models, lifecycle stages, lead management and business process automation. Practical experience troubleshooting CRM issues, maintaining data quality and managing system configurations. Experience with CRM integrations, data synchronization or API-based connectivity between business systems. Understanding of marketing automation concepts, including email automation, lead nurturing, segmentation and campaign reporting. Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. English fluency, German would be an advantage This position is for a company that fosters innovation and values collaboration. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Argentina Remote Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. About the Role We’re looking for a S enior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month. Location: Remote-first (Argentina) Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position) Application Information: Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled This posting is for a new position. As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will: Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP. Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on. Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments. Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy. Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation. Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence. About you You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you: Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime. Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like. Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle. Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles. Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP. Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact. items.description: Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses. We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it. We’re looking for someone excited to pitch the vision of Airtable, implement creative solutions and negotiation tactics that mitigate churn, and identify new and strategic opportunities at renewal time that drive expansion. As a Renewals Associate on our Sales team, you will be the architect of these conversations, and will collaborate with multiple internal stakeholders (Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Deal Desk, etc.) to help to ensure that our customers realize value, and are set up for longterm, sustained success with Airtable. For work locations in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York, the on-target earnings range for this role is $98,000 - $127,700 USD. For all other work locations (including remote), the range is $88,000 - $115,400 USD. Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. items.description: The ROLE Title Customer Success Manager Company Measure Marketing (MMR), a Toronto-based GEO, AI search and SEO agency Type Full-time Reports to Head of Delivery (confirm) Clients B2B, law firms, signage, SaaS, and residential and commercial home improvement Search Changed the Map. You’re the Client’s GPS. Buyers don’t just Google anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google’s AI Overviews, and they often get an answer without ever clicking. That shift is why MMR exists: we help clients get found, cited and chosen across both classic and AI-powered search. This role exists because great work only counts when the client can see it. You’re the person who turns rankings, AI citations, traffic and leads into a clear story of progress. You catch risk before the client feels it, and you keep every account moving toward measurable outcomes. Think of it as a marathon run at sprint pace. Relationships last for years, but you prove value every single month. What You’ll Own 1. Relationships That Fuel Retention Be each client’s trusted partner and main point of contact. Run check-ins , monthly and quarterly reviews that prove progress and set the next 90-day sprint. Handle escalations calmly and drive fast, accountable fixes. 2. Full-Funnel Performance: AI Search, SEO and PPC Explain AI search shifts in plain English, including AI Overviews, zero-click results and citations in ChatGPT and Perplexity. Read paid search performance in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including spend, CPC, conversions and cost per lead, and flag when budget isn’t turning into pipeline. Connect GEO, AEO, SEO and PPC to outcomes: visibility, qualified traffic, leads and cost per lead. Own the narrative while specialists handle execution. 3. Content and CRO Insight Link content plans to client goals, and flag gaps for both search and AI engines. Raise the alarm when traffic or ad clicks grow but leads stay flat, then drive CRO fixes with the web team. 4. Data Storytelling, Human in the Loop Turn data from GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, agency reporting tools and HubSpot into a monthly value story: what happened, why it matters and what’s next. Use AI to draft reports, summarize calls and spot patterns. You verify the output, apply judgment and own every word the client sees. 5. The Retention System Score every account based on leads and account health, customer sentiment, and run recovery plans for any account in Yellow or Red. Escalate any account that stays Red for more than 30 days. Pass expansion opportunities to the growth team when clients are winning. 6. Projects, ClickUp and Automation Turn success plans into ClickUp projects with owners, milestones and deadlines, and keep HubSpot clean. Coordinate the SEO, PPC, content, web and dev teams while protecting scope and margin. Automate repetitive reporting and follow-ups with AI and workflow tools. What You Bring Must-Haves 3+ years in customer success or account management at a digital marketing agency, SEO/SaaS company or similar B2B service business. A working understanding of SEO and PPC (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), plus curiosity and early knowledge of AI search, GEO and AEO. Comfort with numbers: you can read GA4, Search Console and dashboard data and explain what changed and why. Proven ability to turn data into a clear, persuasive story for business owners and executives. Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research, reporting and communication, plus the judgment to check their output. Experience running projects in ClickUp or a similar tool (Asana, Monday) and keeping a CRM like HubSpot clean. Confidence in tough conversations, including pushback, scope creep and at-risk renewals. Professional fluency in English, written and spoken, with North American clients. Nice-to-Haves Experience with tracking and reporting tools, and reporting platforms. Basic CRO knowledge, such as landing page best practices, A/B testing and conversion tracking. Experience with workflow automation (Zapier, ClickUp automations). Background with B2B customers and an asset to know SaaS clients. Familiarity with net revenue retention, upsell motions and customer lifetime value. You are measured on customer results, relationships and expansions. Measured through customer NPS survey and retained revenue. You’re part relationship builder, part data storyteller and part project driver. You don’t wait for clients to raise concerns. You see the dip in the dashboard first, figure out why, and walk in with a plan. You use AI to move faster, but you never hand it the wheel. You’re curious about where search is heading, and you can explain it to a business owner in two minutes without jargon. Most of all, you own outcomes. Great relationships matter, but at MMR they’re backed by measurable results. How to Apply Apply through our JazzHR careers page. You’ll answer a few short questions as part of your application. They show us how you think, so give them five minutes.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions. You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience. The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas. This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce). This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth. Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation. Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar). Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations). Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity. Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design). Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives. Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy). Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page. Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture. Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression. Compensation Transparency: The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-senior-website-manager

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - USA About the Role Cybercrime doesn't wait for anyone to catch up to it, and neither do we. Abnormal AI is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our SLED team, selling behavioral AI security solutions into large, complex State, Local, and Education agencies within a defined territory. We didn't bolt AI onto old security tools. We built our platform from AI up, to catch the human-targeted attacks that legacy tools miss, and public sector organizations need that protection as much as anyone. The ideal candidate is local to the Sacramento area and brings experience selling cybersecurity solutions into large public sector environments , particularly Enterprise-level SLED organizations, along with: Proven hunter focused on selling to large state and local government agencies, with a disciplined approach to early pipeline development and prospecting. Skilled at leveraging all five demand generation pillars: AE prospecting, SDRs, marketing, channel partnerships, and customer referrals. Strong qualifier with the ability to uncover public sector pain points and map them to compelling, value-driven solutions. Effective presenter who tailors demos and messaging to resonate with government stakeholders and address their specific challenges. Process-oriented with a consistent sales methodology and strong time management skills to manage multiple deals efficiently. Data-disciplined, maintaining accurate and up-to-date account and opportunity data across systems. Experienced in building business cases that quantify ROI and value for diverse public sector audiences, including IT, procurement, and leadership. Knowledge sharer who captures and organizes customer insights and lessons learned to support team learning. Skilled at guiding public sector customers through complex internal buying processes, including procurement and RFP cycles. Resilient and resourceful, with a strong track record of success in early-stage environments. Effective at leveraging internal teams such as Sales Engineering, Marketing, BDRs, Product, and Customer Success to drive results in the SLED space. What You Will Do Sell Abnormal AI solutions to large Enterprise SLED agencies with a mandate to overachieve new annual recurring revenue quota, not just hit it. Run the full deal cycle in your accounts: first conversation, technical evaluation, contract signature, and the upsell conversations that follow once they're a customer. Prospect and build new business opportunities to keep your pipeline ahead of target. Sell a platform that's actively expanding underneath you: what started as email security now covers identity, AI security, and insider threat, giving you more surface area to bring value to every agency. Partner with Customer Success to protect timely renewals and surface expansion opportunities. Keep your data sharp across Salesforce, Highspot, and Close Plan, because accurate pipeline is how the whole team plans and wins. Be the customer's advocate inside Abnormal, working with Sales Engineering, Product, and Marketing to get the right things prioritized so more revenue closes, faster. Must Haves Enterprise SLED Account Hunter: 8+ years of direct (not overlay) enterprise sales experience prospecting and closing large, complex SLED accounts. A proven track record of both closing new account logos and growing existing accounts through cross-sell and upsell within the State of California. Negotiation skill that holds up against large organizations and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. A track record to back it up: consistent over-quota performance, ideally top 5% of your sales org. Technical fluency across security, email, cloud, and AI, enough to hold your own in a conversation with a security or IT leader. Cybersecurity or security-adjacent SaaS sales experience, selling subscription software to CISOs and security personnel. A builder's mindset: you've thrived somewhere early-stage, an underdog, or up against bigger incumbents, and you know how to build territory with limited resources. Comfort selling within a company that's still writing its next chapter. We're growing 40%+ year over year, protecting more than 4,500 customers including over 25% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means more to sell, more to learn, and more room to make your mark than a mature market leader can offer. #LI-LB2 Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-account-executive-sled-sacramento-only

This will include site selection, feasibility, budgeting, design team & contractor selection, project management, build-out, and regulatory re
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://gilbertpharmaceuticals.com/ The Head of Design, Development, & Construction will own the entire end to end process of launching new compounding pharmacies nationally. This will include site selection, feasibility, budgeting, design team & contractor selection, project management, build-out, and regulatory readiness of all Gilbert Pharmaceuticals pharmacy facilities. Reporting to the Director of Pharmacy Development & Operations, this role bridges pharmacy operations expertise with construction, facilities engineering, and regulatory compliance to bring new pharmacy sites from concept through licensure and go-live. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience designing and building efficient commercial spaces and pharmacy environments including traditional 503A compounding pharmacies and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities operating under current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) Standards. Their thorough knowledge enables them to successfully navigate state and federal regulations required for pharmacy facility approval. At Gilbert Pharmaceuticals , every role is AI-first. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into the right tools to explore and execute, is tested with real users and stakeholders, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of how we work, not side experiments. We are looking for people who take full ownership of their work, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building a company that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered. We're Looking For You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You have care for performance, accessibility, and reliability as part of craft. You are passionate and proficient in written and verbal communication, and comfort pairing with designers, engineers, and marketers. Key Responsibilities Acquisition Lead market analysis and site selection to identify viable pharmacy locations nationally. Conduct feasibility assessments and due diligence on prospective sites, evaluating regulatory feasibility, build-out complexity, and operational suitability. Develop and execute entitlement strategy for new pharmacy locations in coordination with legal and operations teams. Act as liaison between landlords, brokers, and Gilbert Pharmaceuticals on your prospective sites. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to supply landlords and brokers with essential company information to secure new leases and site acquisitions. Entitlements Navigate land use and zoning requirements for each new pharmacy site. Lead master plan coordination and manage environmental compliance obligations across all facility projects. Oversee community outreach efforts and represent Gilbert Pharmaceuticals at public hearings as needed. Coordinate regulatory submissions and interface directly with operations team on state Boards of Pharmacy, DEA, FDA, and local authorities for facility inspections and approvals. Develop and maintain a facility compliance playbook for new site design and existing facility modifications. Design Lead concept and programming strategy for all new pharmacy facilities, translating operational workflows into effective, compliant physical environments. Manage design team selection and coordination, including architects, MEP engineers, and specialty consultants. Lead the architectural design and space planning for new pharmacy locations, including compounding suites, sterile and non-sterile areas, clean rooms, and dispensing environments. Develop detailed facility design standards and specifications aligned with USP <795>, USP <797>, USP <800>, applicable state Board of Pharmacy requirements, and FDA cGMP requirements for 503B outsourcing facilities. Review and approve architectural drawings, construction documents, and engineering plans for all new pharmacy projects. Design scalable production environments for 503A and 503B operations, including batch manufacturing areas, quarantine/release zones, and controlled material flow segregation. Develop HVAC, cleanroom, airflow, and environmental monitoring specifications in coordination with engineering and operating partners. Coordinate with operating partners to ensure facility design supports validated processes, environmental monitoring programs, and batch production controls. Pre-Con Develop project budgets and oversee value engineering exercises to optimize cost without compromising regulatory or operational standards. Lead GC selection processes, evaluating contractors for pharmacy build-out experience, compliance track record, and execution capability. Manage permit management across all active projects, ensuring timely approvals from local building authorities and regulatory bodies. Develop and track project timelines, procurement schedules, and risk mitigation plans across multiple concurrent site developments. Construction Serve as Owner's representative throughout construction, maintaining accountability for design intent, budget, and schedule. Provide field oversight through regular site inspections and quality walkthroughs to ensure regulatory and operational standards are met. Maintain rigorous cost control across all active build-outs, managing change orders and contractor performance. Oversee FF&E installation and commissioning of all pharmacy-specific equipment and systems. Manage QA & closeout activities including installation qualifications of critical manufacturing utilities (e.g., WFI systems, clean steam, environmental monitoring) where applicable to 503A and 503B facilities. Drive operational readiness in partnership with pharmacy operations and quality teams, ensuring facilities are inspection-ready as soon as possible. Maintain up-to-date documentation including as-built drawings, equipment lists, and SOPs for all facility environments. Support evaluation of pharmacy partners by assessing the design and regulatory readiness of their existing facilities. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, or Chemical), Pharmacy, or a closely related field; advanced degree or licensure preferred. 5+ years of experience designing, building, or commissioning pharmacy facilities, healthcare environments, or regulated laboratory/cleanroom spaces. Ability to understand/learn USP <795>, USP <797>, USP <800>, and applicable state Board of Pharmacy facility requirements. Demonstrated project management experience overseeing construction projects from design through commissioning. Experience interfacing with regulatory agencies on facility approvals and inspections. Proficiency with architectural drawings, construction documents, and facility engineering specifications. Experience designing or supporting sterile manufacturing or 503B outsourcing facilities operating under cGMP environments strongly preferred. Ability to travel to pharmacy sites as needed for construction oversight, inspections, and go-live support. Preferred Licensed Architect (AIA), Professional Engineer (PE), or Certified Pharmaceutical Industry Professional (CPIP). Familiarity with digital health or telehealth-linked pharmacy models. Strong vendor management experience working with contractors, engineers, and equipment suppliers. What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months) Documented pharmacy facility design standards and a reusable build-out playbook for new sites. Streamlined project flow to maximize efficiency and completion time per project. Documented budgets for all existing and prospective sites with cost efficient suggestions to scale nationally. Successful delivery of at least three to five new 503A pharmacy facilities on time, on budget, and licensed for operation. Successful delivery of at least one 503B pharmacy facility on time, on budget, and licensed for operation. All existing partner facilities assessed and documented against Gilbert's compliance standards. Strong cross-functional relationships established with pharmacy operations, contracting, and external vendor teams. Benefits Base salary, equity, and bonus structure are open to discussion based on experience and fit. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gilbert-pharmaceuticals-head-of-design-development-construction

items.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
items.summary: Who We Are Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.Â Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role. Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion. Working here means: High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected Mission-driven teamwork: weâre passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it. Learn more about what itâs like to work with us here:Â politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers The Role In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.Â The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firmâs financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.Â This role serves as the firmâs first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firmâs systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations. Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support. The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.Â What You'll Do Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firmâs needs, but will include a combination of the following: Financial Operations ManagementÂ Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time. Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly. Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.Â Â Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.Â Â Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.Â Â Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.Â Â Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time. Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and ForecastingÂ Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time. Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.Â Â Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.Â Â Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed. Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.Â Â Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.Â Â Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.Â Â Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.Â Â Billing, Collections, and Accounts ReceivableÂ Own and continuously improve the firmâs billing and collections process.Â Â Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.Â Â Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.Â Â Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.Â Â Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.Â Â Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.Â Â Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firmâs financial interests.Â Â Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.Â Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances. Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.Â Â Trust Accounting and ComplianceÂ Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.Â Â Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.Â Â Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.Â Â Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.Â Â Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.Â Â Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.Â Â Internal Controls and Risk ManagementÂ Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.Â Â Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.Â Â Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.Â Â Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.Â Â Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.Â Â Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.Â Â Finance Team and Vendor OversightÂ Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.Â Â Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.Â Â Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.Â Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.Â Â Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.Â Â Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.Â Â Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows. Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows. Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.Â Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.Â Â Financial Analysis and Business SupportÂ Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.Â Â Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.Â Â Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.Â Â Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.Â Â Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.Â Â Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.Â Who You Are We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings: Required QualificationsÂ Bachelorâs degree in Accounting or Finance Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.Â Â Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.Â Â Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.Â Â Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.Â Â Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools. Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems. Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required. Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.Â Â Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.Â Â Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.Â Â High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.Â Â Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment. Â Â Preferred QualificationsÂ CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.Â Â 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.Â Â Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred. Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.Â Â Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.Â Â Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.Â Â Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial performance reports.Â Â Experience supervising bookkeepers, billing specialists, payroll providers, or outsourced accounting vendors.Â Â Advanced experience with complex unstructured data models and analysis, pricing analysis, SKU profitability, labor utilization, realization, collection rate analysis, and cost-of-acquisition reporting.Â Â Experience supporting strategic planning, cash flow planning, debt repayment planning, and owner distribution planning.Â What We Offer This position offers a monthly salary range of USD 3,000 - 3,500 gross, commensurate with experience and qualifications. â Week between Christmas and New Year's â office closed, fully paid â Your country's national public holidays off (paid) - your paid national holidays follow your own country's calendar â Three weeks of paid vacation annually â Comprehensive training program â we invest in bringing you up to speed on our systems, content processes, and best practices â Mentorship and collaboration â learn from experienced team members and contribute your expertise â Career advancement paths â we promote from within and create opportunities â Work from anywhere â this position is open to candidates based in Argentina. â Equipment support â stipend or provided equipment to set up your home office, available after 4 months on the job How to Apply To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter, both of which must be in English. Your application won't be considered without a cover letter. Your cover letter should explain why you're uniquely qualified for this particular position, and why you would be a great fit for our law firm. Generic, copy/paste cover letters will be discarded. Upload your cover letter and resume, in PDF format, through the software program where you're viewing this announcement. Please do not call or email us about this opening. Please mention the word **WONDERFUL** and tag RNC4yNDIuMTk2LjE1MA== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNC4yNDIuMTk2LjE1MA==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
