documented.Â Â Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.Â Â Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.Â Â Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.Â Â Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.Â Â Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.Â Â Internal Controls and Risk ManagementÂ Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.Â Â Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.Â Â Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.Â Â Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.Â Â Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.Â Â Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.Â Â Finance Team and Vendor OversightÂ Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.Â Â Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.Â Â Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.Â Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.Â Â Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.Â Â Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.Â Â Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows. Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows. Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.Â Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.Â Â Financial Analysis and Business SupportÂ Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.Â Â Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.Â Â Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.Â Â Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.Â Â Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.Â Â Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.Â Who You Are We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems. Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required. Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.Â Â Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.Â Â Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.Â Â High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.Â Â Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment. Â Â Preferred QualificationsÂ CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.Â Â 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.Â Â Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred. Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.Â Â Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.Â Â Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.Â Â Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial performance reports.Â Â Experience supervising bookkeepers, billing specialists, payroll providers, or outsourced accounting vendors.Â Â Advanced experience with complex unstructured data models and analysis, pricing analysis, SKU profitability, labor utilization, realization, collection rate analysis, and cost-of-acquisition reporting.Â Â Experience supporting strategic planning, cash flow planning, debt repayment planning, and owner distribution planning.Â What We Offer This position offers a monthly salary range of USD 3,000 - 3,500 gross, commensurate with experience and qualifications. â Week between Christmas and New Year's â office closed, fully paid â Your country's national public holidays off (paid) - your paid national holidays follow your own country's calendar â Three weeks of paid vacation annually â Comprehensive training program â we invest in bringing you up to speed on our systems, content processes, and best practices â Mentorship and collaboration â learn from experienced team members and contribute your expertise â Career advancement paths â we promote from within and create opportunities â Work from anywhere â this position is open to candidates based in Argentina. â Equipment support â stipend or provided equipment to set up your home office, available after 4 months on the job How to Apply To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter, both of which must be in English. items.title: Technical Customer Support
items.summary: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Who You Are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A Plus If You Have Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How We Work Together You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer. Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask. Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked. The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. Benefits Contract type: full-time or part-time Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099). items.summary: About DEUNA ð§¡ DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNAâthe fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin AmericaâATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution. With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexicoâs digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation. We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! ð Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us! About the Role As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants after their initial go-live. You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions. For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform. Your mission is to help ensure every merchant is operationally stable, technically satisfied, and continuously improving on DEUNA. Responsibilities Proactively monitor merchant technical health Monitor merchant performance, transaction behavior, errors, declines, latency, and anomalies. Identify potential risks before they become merchant-impacting issues. Raise internal flags when technical or operational risks are detected. Help maintain account-specific dashboards, alerts, and health views for key merchants. Be the main technical contact after go-live Act as the primary technical point of contact for merchant questions and doubts after go-live. Help merchants understand technical flows, configurations, integrations, and platform behavior. Coordinate internally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Account Management when merchant needs require cross-functional support. Support technical incident management Triage merchant-reported and internally detected issues. Escalate issues to the appropriate on-call, Engineering, Product, or Operations teams. Track resolution and ensure timely internal and external follow-up. Help ensure communication with merchants is clear, factual, and timely. Support post-incident follow-up, including impact explanation, corrective actions, and prevention measures when required. Drive merchant technical improvements Identify opportunities to improve merchant performance, stability, acceptance rate, routing behavior, fraud flows, provider configuration, or processing cost. Partner with Account Management to support merchant expansion and long-term account growth. Help merchants adopt new payment methods, providers, features, or technical capabilities after launch. Build merchant health visibility Build and deliver simple Merchant Health Reports periodically to Account Management and/or merchants. Maintain accurate technical documentation for merchant-specific configurations, customizations, providers, integrations, and known risks. Help prioritize and advocate for merchantsâ technical needs internally. Requirements 3+ years in Technical Account Management, Merchant Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or similar roles. Strong technical understanding of online payment ecosystems, including APIs, SDKs, transaction flows, processors, acquirers, fraud tools, chargebacks, refunds, captures, and 3DS. Experience with incident management, post-launch technical operations, technical troubleshooting, and client-facing support. Ability to analyze logs, dashboards, error patterns, transaction behavior, and operational metrics. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Strong organization, ownership, urgency, and follow-up discipline. Fluent in Spanish and English. Experience working with LatAm merchants is a must. Startup environment experience is a plus. What Success Looks Like A successful TAM helps premium merchants feel that DEUNA is actively watching over their payment operation, not simply reacting when something breaks. The TAM should help ensure that: Merchant issues are detected and escalated quickly. Critical incidents are followed through with urgency and ownership. Merchants receive clear and timely technical communication. Account Management has strong technical support to retain and expand key accounts. Merchants continuously improve their technical performance and payment outcomes on DEUNA. \n \n What will you find when you join DEUNA? - A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM - Dynamism, agility and constant innovation - Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region - The best tools and technology to operate - Being part of the startup culture. - We are in full expansion! items.description: We are seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to lead end-to-end financial planning, reporting, and forecasting for operating expenses across the organization. In this role, you will own cost center analysis, drive forecast consolidation, manage systems integrity between TM1 and NetSuite, and serve as a strategic finance business partner to department leaders across the company. The ideal candidate brings strong financial modeling expertise, hands-on experience with corporate planning tools, and the confidence to constructively challenge operational teams on budget assumptions while translating complex numbers into actionable business narratives. Responsibilities: Own the FP&A OpEx close—analyzing variances, preparing monthly management reporting packs (P&L, dashboards, board inputs), and partnering with Accounting on accruals and prepayments. Own planning, trend analysis, and variance commentary for non-people OpEx (software, marketing, T&E, professional services). Track cost efficiency metrics and ensure accurate TM1 mapping. Lead annual OpEx budget cycles and recurring reforecasts. Build dynamic, driver-based forecasting models and support Long-Range Planning (LRP) scenario modeling. Consolidate OpEx, workforce, and revenue forecasts into a single defensible group view in TM1. Support the FP&A Director in presenting to the CFO, ELT, and Board. Act as the strategic finance partner to department heads - translating numbers into actionable insights, constructively challenging spend assumptions, and flagging risks/opportunities. Ensure TM1 remains the single source of truth vs. NetSuite actuals. Drive reporting automation, refine Google Sheets dashboards, and streamline close/budget cycles. 5-7+ years in finance with 2–3+ years in FP&A. Experience owning end-to-end close/budget cycles and partnering directly with non-finance stakeholders. Tech, SaaS, or scale-up background strongly preferred. Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills. Hands-on experience with corporate planning tools (TM1/Cognos is a strong plus; Anaplan/Adaptive) and ERP systems (NetSuite preferred). Strong grasp of core accounting concepts (accruals, prepayments, opex vs. capex). Commercial mindset, structured thinking, strong communication skills, and the confidence to challenge budget assumptions constructively. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field (ACCA/CIMA/CFA or Master's is a plus). Fluent in English (Lithuanian is an advantage). About us PVcase is moving solar forward with an alternative to the traditional labor-intensive, time-consuming, error-prone solar project development process. With our sophisticated site selection, PV design, and yield estimation software, you can achieve maximum results in a fraction of the time — to succeed faster, build better, and accelerate the global transition to clean energy. PVcase ends clunky processes and corrupted data to clear the path to a net-zero economy. Whether you use a single product or plug into the entire platform, our end-to-end site selection, design, and yield assessment software makes you faster, precise, and highly productive at every stage of project development. PVcase is a leading choice for solar energy professionals — our platform serves over 1,800 customers in 75+ countries, powering the development of more than 4 TW of projects a year. Get ready to enjoy Flex benefit package, customizing perks to match your unique style. Enjoy unlimited remote work or join the vibrant offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, or Barcelona. Flexible working hours, harmonizing your personal and professional life. Half-day Summer Fridays. Full training and onboarding program for a seamless start. Exclusive work only with international markets. Considerable & steadily increasing salary, recognizing and rewarding your dedication. Frequent in-office and after-hours activities with team members. Participation in international training programs. Internal transparency with company results and salary system, promoting a culture of trust and collaboration. Additional paid vacation days, including birthdays, volunteering, and other occasions. Salary Range: Lithuania: 45,100 - 60,000 EUR gross/yearly. Spain: 37,200 - 50,000 EUR gross/yearly. items.description: Software Engineering About the team The Industry Software organization builds the B2B SaaS platforms that power Zillow's software and services for real estate professionals, including: - Home listing, lead delivery, and home shopper lifecycle workflows - Identity and access: account hierarchies, user identity, team roster/permissions management - Enterprise integrations: broker rosters, listing feeds, partner data pipelines - Monetization: purchasing, pricing, billing, entitlements, and internal tooling for sales, support, and operations We work in tight partnership with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Customer Support, and Finance to build an integrated, reliable, and scalable B2B ecosystem for our industry customers - and we aim to do it smart, humble, hardworking, and highly collaborative. About the role We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to own some of the most complex, strategically important initiatives in Industry Software - multi-team, cross-organizational programs that span multiple product areas, from strategy and scope through execution, launch, and post-launch learning. You'll act as a thought partner to senior and executive leaders, bridge Product, Engineering, and Design to create clarity from ambiguity, and build deep expertise across our domains (monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, real estate SaaS and lead delivery) while operating as a strong generalist who ramps up quickly elsewhere. You'll operate at both strategic and tactical levels: energized by building structure where little exists, balancing technical depth with strong stakeholder management, and setting direction while rolling up your sleeves to get high-quality work done on time. What You'll Do Strategy and planning : Define cross-org initiatives that align with Industry Software and broader Zillow B2B priorities; translate strategy into program charters, success metrics, and multi-release execution plans; shape scope and sequencing with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders. Execution and delivery : Own the program lifecycle end to end - planning, dependency mapping, execution, launch, and post-launch follow-through - and drive the operating rhythms (status reviews, dependency checkpoints, release readiness) that keep teams delivering reliably, without subsuming team-level agile ceremonies owned by EMs and PMs. Risk and metrics : Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks early; drive mitigation and tradeoff decisions with leadership; use data to measure program health and guide iterative improvement. Stakeholder communication : Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations; communicate status, risks, and decisions in a crisp, executive-ready narrative up to VP/SVP level. Technical leadership : Build working knowledge of the systems, APIs, and data flows within your program scope; partner with Principal Engineers and architects to shape technical approach; ramp up quickly across domains like monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, and real estate SaaS/lead delivery. TPM craft : Define and refine planning, risk, and reporting best practices for Industry Software; mentor other TPMs as a force multiplier for program management excellence; use AI-native tools to increase program efficiency and decision speed. Who you are 8+ years in Technical Program Management (or equivalent), leading large-scale, multi-team, cross-org programs - including portfolio-level and multi-quarter planning - at mid-size or large companies. Preferred Qualifications Deep experience in one or more Industry Software domains - identity and access, monetization and billing, enterprise integrations, or real estate SaaS and lead delivery - or in adjacent complex B2B platforms (ecommerce, fintech, ad tech), ideally within a platform or internal tools organization where reliability and partner integration are critical. Demonstrated experience mentoring TPMs or shaping TPM best practices within an organization. Familiarity with AI and modern collaboration tooling (program dashboards, automation, document generation) to streamline program management. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market. This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value. What You'll Do Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals. Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles. Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements. Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors. Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion. Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles. Forecast accurately and provide clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively managing and progressing opportunities. Skills We're Looking For 8+ years of large enterprise software sales experience and well-developed pattern recognition for navigating complex organizations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle. In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players. You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities. You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment. You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast. You are extremely organized. You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop. You are a strategic thinker. You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way. You are a problem solver. You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem. You are enthusiastic! You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude. Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings. As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process. The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. Pay Range $151,351 — $189,189 USD OTE (On Target Earning) $302,702 — $378,378 USD Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . items.summary: Why Now 2026 has been a breakout year for Doppler. We’ve helped over 78,000 startups and enterprises manage their secrets at scale, and landed our first million-dollar customer. We’ve shipped some of our most exciting features yet, expanded our customer base, and sharpened our focus like never before. With a strong foundation in community, we’re sc
items.description: Why Now 2026 has been a breakout year for Doppler. We’ve helped over 78,000 startups and enterprises manage their secrets at scale, and landed our first million-dollar customer. We’ve shipped some of our most exciting features yet, expanded our customer base, and sharpened our focus like never before. With a strong foundation in community, we’re scaling and monetizing with ambitious goals across product, growth, sales, and hiring. The rise of AI tooling has fundamentally expanded who and what has access to your secrets. The stakes have never been higher, and getting it wrong has real consequences. Doppler is the solution to fix this. Simple to adopt, easy to scale, and built for developers, by developers. The momentum is real, and we’re just getting started. About Doppler Doppler’s mission is to make it easy and secure for software developers of every experience level and teams of any size to manage their app configuration and secrets. But hasn’t this been done? Developers tend to be either struggling with the manual management of .env files, or wrestling with an overly complex secrets manager that’s not built for software development. Our team is entrepreneurial, with a bias for action. We never back down from a spirited debate and believe we are all responsible for exploring the hard questions. We value self-awareness and meaningful impact. We are open to unconventional approaches and have learned not to judge a book by its cover. Your time is your most valuable resource, so you set your hours. We use Slack to communicate and default to zero meetings. Who We Are Doppler is a developer-first secrets management platform that enables engineers and security teams to securely store their secrets across any cloud infrastructure or deployment environment at scale. The Role As a Senior Engineer, you’ll help build the next phase of scale for a platform that 78,000+ teams trust with their most sensitive data, using industry-leading techniques, and you’ll blaze the path for reliable agentic patterns at Doppler. We’re looking for an engineering-first mind: someone with strong technical fundamentals and principles who is also deeply engaged with AI and understands the shape of the emerging industry. You know that AI amplifies good engineering judgment rather than replacing it. You care about building systems that are correct, fast, and secure by default, and you’re just as comfortable in the infrastructure those systems run on as in the code itself. About the Team Doppler Engineering spans product, data, growth, infrastructure, and security. We’re a security-first team that genuinely cares about the quality of what we build. We collaborate with as little ego as humanly possible and are constantly trying to improve how we work and deliver software. What you’ll do: Design, build, own, operate, and support the services, APIs, and data systems at the center of Doppler’s product. Build the next phase of scale at Doppler, including reliability, performance, and the infrastructure underneath, using industry-leading techniques. Blaze the path for reliable agentic patterns at Doppler: shared context, guardrails, and review practices that make agents genuinely useful while keeping human judgment in the loop. Lead by example in how you work with AI, and help the engineers around you move faster without sacrificing security or quality. Own the design of the systems you build, and influence the standards the rest of the team builds against. Collaborate with engineers throughout the team to turn ambiguous product problems into systems we can operate confidently for years. Approach everything you do from a security-first perspective. Raise the bar around you through code review, design review, and mentorship. What you’ll bring to the table: 5+ years of experience building and operating production software systems. Strong technical fundamentals, with strong opinions (loosely held) about service and API design. Strong data experience: schema design, query performance, and migrations against live traffic. Experience with distributed systems: the failure modes, the tradeoffs, and the discipline of designing for both. You’ve run production systems at scale and made big changes to them without taking them down. You own your services end to end: shipping, reading the dashboards, and debugging in production. Deep, daily fluency with AI and agentic tooling. You know where it shines, where it fails, and how to move faster without sacrificing security or quality, and you want to teach others the same. Genuine engagement with where the AI industry is heading, and the ability to separate what’s real from what’s hype. Sound human judgment: you own every line you ship, can explain and defend it without the tool, and know when not to reach for an agent. A pragmatic sense of when a problem deserves a robust solution and when it deserves a simple one, guided by the value to the business. Comfortable jumping into situations that don’t perfectly match the job description and being helpful anyway. Has no problem saying “I don’t know”, but does have a problem with stopping there. Preferred experience: Knowledge and passion for security-first engineering. Experience with typed languages, especially Go and/or TypeScript. Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform [preferred], Ansible, Pulumi, etc), and a major cloud provider (GCP [preferred], AWS, or Azure; we’re on GCP). Experience building multi-tenant systems with isolation guarantees. Experience designing or maintaining a public API that other engineers depend on in a scaled production environment. Experience releasing and supporting multiple versions in tandem. Passion for mentoring others and shaping engineering culture. Benefits Premium health insurance (medical, dental, vision) Guilt-free Unlimited PTO - 3-week minimum strongly encouraged! Upward Mobility Learning and Development Stipend Wealth Advisor 401k Pregnancy & Family Leave Fertility & Adoption Benefits Equal Compensation (regardless of gender or race) For a full list of our benefits check our Perks Notion Page. Closing We’ve built a great product our customers love. Our churn is low, and active usage continues to rise. We just need to amplify our reach to educate the market that secrets management can be fast, secure, and affordable for teams and organizations of any size. And most importantly, we need to continue encouraging Developers to stop adhering to archaic insecure standards such as manually managing .env file formats. Are you passionate about developer-focused products and ready to join an amazing team? Then we want to hear from you! A final note - we highly encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don’t feel entirely qualified, or entirely sure. You never know!

items.description: Sprout Social is looking to hire a Financial Planning &Analysis Analyst, Corporate FP&A, for the Finance team. This role reports to the Director of Corporate FP&A and is based in the Philippines. Why join Sprout’s Finance team? At Sprout Social, our Finance team powers the strategy behind helping leading brands unlock the value of social intelligence. We act as the company’s fiscal backbone - equipping leaders with insights to make smart decisions, while delivering a seamless experience for customers and meeting the demands of a dynamic public company. You’ll join a collaborative team grounded in accuracy and operational excellence, where your work directly impacts Sprout’s success. We foster a culture of high standards and continuous learning, giving you the opportunity to grow your expertise while making meaningful contributions. What you’ll do Consolidate headcount and P&L forecasts in Pigment, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness across each planning cycle. Deliver on critical ELT, Board, and Investor Relations (IR) updates, translating complex financial data into clear, decision-ready materials. Drive the close process in Pigment, partnering closely with Accounting to ensure actuals are accurately reflected, reconciled, and reported on time. Contribute to ad hoc modeling and analysis in support of corporate finance initiatives, executive requests, and strategic projects. Own key corporate reports and dashboards in Pigment, ensuring stakeholders across the business have reliable, accurate, and timely access to financial data. Partner with the Senior Manager, Corporate/G&A FP&A and the FP&A Systems & AI Manager to support broader planning processes and systems initiatives across the Corporate FP&A team. What you’ll bring You are a detail-oriented, analytically strong finance professional who thrives on accuracy and ownership. You’re comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple deliverables against firm close and reporting deadlines, and you take pride in being the person others can rely on to get the numbers right. The minimum qualifications for this role include: 3-5+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, or a related analytical finance role. Experience with headcount and P&L forecasting or consolidation. Experience supporting executive-level reporting (ELT, Board, or IR), with the ability to work accurately against tight, recurring deadlines tied to close and reporting cycles. Strong financial modeling and Excel skills, with sound analytical judgment and attention to detail. Comfort operating with a degree of ambiguity, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to articulate financial concepts to global stakeholders. Ability to work from 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM CT (6:00 PM – 3:00 AM PHT). Preferred qualifications for this role include: Hands-on experience with Pigment or a comparable EPM/planning tool (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive Planning). Experience in a public company or high-growth SaaS environment. Experience with NetSuite or a similar ERP system as part of the close process. Demonstrated ability to contribute to ad hoc modeling and cross-functional analysis beyond core reporting responsibilities. How you’ll grow Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including: Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization. Partner with your manager to align on early priorities, define success in the role, and build a working command of Sprout’s Pigment environment, corporate reporting cadence, and close process. Shadow the current close cycle, ELT/Board reporting process, and key corporate dashboards to understand how they come together today. Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by: Independently owning your portion of the headcount and P&L consolidation process in Pigment. Contributing directly to ELT, Board, and IR reporting materials with increasing autonomy. Supporting the close process with accuracy and minimal rework, building trust with Accounting and FP&A partners. Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through: Owning key corporate reports and dashboards in Pigment end-to-end, with minimal oversight. Proactively flagging data or process issues before they become reporting risks. Taking on ad hoc modeling requests with sound judgment on approach and prioritization. Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by: Operating as a trusted, go-to analytical partner within the Corporate FP&A team. Driving improvements to existing reporting processes and dashboards in Pigment, reducing manual effort where possible. Taking on a broader scope of corporate reporting and modeling responsibilities as the team and business scale. Of course, what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager. Our Benefits Program We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive benefits program: Comprehensive Health Coverage: A 23,299 PHP monthly allowance to cover your health insurance (HMO) needs. Premium Mental Health Support: Full access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including free coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources. Generous Paid Time Off: 24 days of paid leave, 5 sick days, plus regular holidays, special non-working holidays, and company-wide Rest & Recharge days. Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): An annual $500 USD fund to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being—from gym memberships to hobbies. Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet expenses. Standard Compensation & Pay: We provide a 13th-month salary and adhere to all government-mandated pay premiums, including Night Shift Differential (NSD) and holiday/overtime pay. Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible charitable organizations. High-Quality Equipment: A 13” MacBook and other high-quality equipment to ensure you can do your best work. * This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits. Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills. Our current hiring range for this role: PHP 680,000 – PHP 850,000 annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact. We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth opportunities available as you progress in your role. The full base pay range for this role is PHP 680,000 – PHP 1,020,000 These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed. If you require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the interview process or to submit your application, please email us at accommodations@sproutsocial.com. Include the nature of your request and your preferred contact information. We’ll do everything we can to support your success during our recruitment process while upholding your privacy. Please note that only inquiries regarding accommodations will receive a response from this email address; other inquiries will not be addressed (e.g., you send your resume but are not requesting an accommodation). Candidates for this remote work opportunity must be based in the Philippines. If you are based in another location within APAC, we aren’t able to hire in your location at this time. #LI-Remote Sprout Social Inc. and its subsidiaries process personal data submitted through your application to assess your qualifications for employment and to inform our hiring decision and, where applicable, for required governmental reporting. For more information, please review Sprout’s Global Applicant Privacy Notice.

items.description: Software Engineering Company Description A Experian é uma empresa global de dados e tecnologia que impulsiona oportunidades para pessoas e empresas ao redor do mundo. Atuamos em diversos mercados, como serviços financeiros, saúde, automotivo, agronegócio, seguros, entre outros. A Experian investe em pessoas e em novas tecnologias avançadas para liberar o poder dos dados. Contamos com uma equipe incrível de 25.200 colaboradores em 32 países. Nossa singularidade é valorizar a sua. A cultura da Experian, centrada nas pessoas, inclusiva e orientada por propósito, é reconhecida por diversos prêmios - incluindo World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Top 25 global da Fortune) e Great Place To Work™ em 26 países, entre outros. Confira o Experian Life nas redes sociais ou explore nosso site de carreiras para entender o porquê. A Experian também se orgulha de ser uma empregadora que promove igualdade de oportunidades e ação afirmativa. Description Descrição do trabalho Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com sólida experiência em microsserviços, perfil analítico e visão técnica para atuar de forma proativa em todas as etapas do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software. Procuramos um(a) profissional capaz de transformar requisitos em soluções escaláveis, com foco na qualidade, inovação e evolução contínua das aplicações críticas para o negócio. Além da excelência técnica, esperamos alguém com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas, boa comunicação, espírito colaborativo e disposição para compartilhar conhecimento e impulsionar a evolução do time. Responsabilidades Atuar em um time multidisciplinar no desenvolvimento de aplicações back-end. Participar ativamente das discussões técnicas, refinamentos e planejamento das entregas. Contribuir em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção até a implantação e sustentação das aplicações. Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando na resolução de problemas complexos. Desenvolver soluções escaláveis com foco em desempenho, disponibilidade e qualidade. Realizar code reviews e garantir a adoção das melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Implementar e manter testes automatizados. Manter a documentação técnica dos serviços atualizada. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua na arquitetura, código e processos. Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe. Requisitos Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita. Capacidade de trabalho em equipe, planejamento, organização e negociação. Sólida experiência com Java 17 ou superior. Experiência com Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data e Spring Batch). Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços, APIs REST e GraphQL. Experiência com testes unitários utilizando JUnit, Mockito ou frameworks similares. Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais. Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes. Conhecimento em princípios SOLID e Design Patterns. Experiência em ambientes AWS, incluindo EKS, EC2, S3, EMR e SQS. Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins. Diferenciais Experiência com Apache Spark utilizando Python ou Scala. Conhecimento em soluções de Big Data, como Data Lake, Data Warehouse, ETL, BI, Data Mesh e MLOps. Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento utilizando Dynatrace, Datadog ou Grafana. Conhecimento em plataformas de mensageria, como RabbitMQ e Kafka. Qualifications Qualificações - Additional Information A Serasa Experian é muito mais do que você imagina. Com o propósito de criar um futuro melhor, ampliando oportunidades para pessoas e empresas, no Brasil somos mais de 4 mil pessoas que atuam em diversos times e especialidades. Aqui, cada conhecimento e diversidade se complementa e você pode trabalhar no que mais ama, estamos comprometidos a construir uma cultura inclusiva e um ambiente no qual pessoas possam equilibrar a carreira com seus compromissos e interesses pessoais, prezando pelo bem-estar. A gente se dedica muito em ser uma das melhores e mais inovadoras empresas para se trabalhar do país, possibilitando experiências e carreiras incríveis para nossas pessoas. Nossa forte abordagem de pessoas em primeiro lugar é reconhecida externamente por meio de diversas certificações de mercado: fomos premiados pelo Great Place To Work™ em 24 países e pela certificação internacional Top Employers, além de sermos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para jovens profissionais e contarmos com uma avaliação de 4,6 no Glassdoor. Cada reconhecimento nos indica que estamos no caminho certo, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho cada vez melhor para nossos talentos. Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here
