items.title: Payments Operations Analyst at Garner Health
items.summary: What you’ll be part of Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using
items.description: What you’ll be part of Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster. The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you’ve ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You’d be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can. Who we want This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As a Payments Operations Analyst, you’ll be part of the Payments team within Claims Operations, reporting to the Payments Operations lead. You’ll help run and improve the operations that move money to our members every week, working directly with the partners who receive it. Your work will directly shape the member experience as Garner grows and launches new ways to reward members for choosing great care. What you will do Run day-to-day payment operations, including weekly payment cycles, funding, and the checks and controls that keep member payments accurate and on time Serve as a point of contact for external payment partners, working through file delivery, funding, error reports, and issue resolution Investigate payment issues end to end: analyze error reports, find the root cause, and drive fixes with internal teams and partners Support new client and partner launches, setting up payment workflows and confirming everything works once real payments start flowing Analyze and resolve payment questions and issues raised by clients, members, and internal teams, within our service standards Help maintain and improve the reporting, trackers, and dashboards that show the status of all payments work Contribute to internal tools, documentation, and process improvements, using automation and AI tools to make recurring work faster and more reliable Raise risks early and keep the right people informed, so issues are resolved before they reach members What we’re looking for 1-4 years of experience in operations, analytics, or a similar role; experience in payments, fintech, payroll, benefits, or healthcare operations is a plus, not a requirement Experience working with external partners or vendors to troubleshoot and resolve issues An analytical mindset with a keen attention to detail; you dig for the root cause before jumping to a fix Comfort working with financial data and reconciliations in Excel/Google Sheets Familiarity with file-based integrations (for example, SFTP, encryption, or file mapping) is a plus Clear, proactive communication with internal teams and external partners, and comfort using AI tools to work faster and more accurately A combination of high ownership mentality and detail orientation, including sound judgment and rigor on high-stakes, sensitive operational work, that has resulted in a track record of delivering operational initiatives on tight deadlines A willingness to “roll up your sleeves” and do whatever is necessary to ensure company success A methodical problem-solver who drives continuous improvement, readily gives and absorbs feedback, and operates with individual accountability and integrity as part of a mission-driven team. A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You’re energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics. Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Compensation Transparency: The base salary range for this position is $65,000 - $78,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k), Teladoc Health and more. Fraud and Security Notice: Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use getgarner.com and garnerhealth.com email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement here and to candidateprotection@garnerhealth.com. Equal Employment Opportunity: Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Garner Health is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at talent@garnerhealth.com.

items.title: Sr. Demand Generation Associate, Life360 Ads at Life360
items.summary: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch
items.description: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com. Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team Life360 Ads is our advertising business. We help advertisers reach relevant audiences across screens, informed by our direct, ongoing relationship with Life360 members. Ads Marketing makes that value clear. We are product marketers, creatives, content and brand people, and event builders, and we work side by side with sellers every day. We say what we think, we move fast, and we judge ourselves by whether our work brings advertisers into the conversation. If you like building from the ground up and seeing your work show up in real deals, you’ll fit right in. About the Job Advertisers get pitched all day. The Sr. Demand Generation Associate builds the system that makes Life360 Ads easy to find, easy to trust, and easy to talk to. You own the path from a first search or click to a sales conversation: website and landing-page operations, search, lead capture and routing, and email and LinkedIn campaign delivery. You’ll partner with the Content Manager, who owns the message and editorial calendar, and with sellers, who follow up with buyers and tell you what is working. Here is the honest starting point. We have HubSpot, but today it mostly runs website forms. We don’t yet have a consistent lead process or clear handoff to sellers. You will build this in stages with the Senior Director, Sales, and Sales Operations. First, make forms, seller handoff, event follow-up, essential website updates, and basic reporting reliable. Next, launch focused account campaigns, email follow-up, and selected paid campaigns. Add more advanced scoring, search improvements, and testing as the basics work and buyer activity supports them. You’ll report to the Senior Director of Ads Marketing. The Senior Director and events team handle paid media relationships and negotiations with industry partners; you support campaign tracking and buyer follow-up. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $102k - 152k USD. We take into consideration an individual’s background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits[, as well as equity: confirm with HR]. What You’ll Do Build our first lead process with Sales: agree on lead stages, buyer fit, a qualified opportunity, follow-up timing, and routing. Start with simple rules and clear next steps; introduce more advanced scoring when useful data is available. Own Marketing’s use of HubSpot and the lead handoff into Salesforce. Partner with Sales Operations and system administrators on integration, permissions, account ownership, data quality, and reporting. Coordinate changes with the teams that control the systems. Own Life360 Ads website and landing-page operations. Build and improve pages within the available tools, partnering with life360.com owners, developers, and agencies for technical work. Content owns the words and Design owns the visual assets; you own forms, testing, tracking, and conversion. Lead search-engine optimization (SEO) for Life360 Ads. Prioritize keyword strategy, useful page structure, and on-page improvements, and brief developers on technical fixes and structured data. Sequence the work against buyer needs and available support. Improve visibility in AI search: work with Content on clear, accurate pages that answer advertiser questions, coordinate technical improvements, and track observable citations and referrals. Use what we learn to improve; placement in AI answers is not guaranteed. Plan, run, and improve selected paid search and LinkedIn lead-generation campaigns, with priorities and spending agreed with the Senior Director. Establish reliable tracking and Sales follow-up before expanding. Own email and LinkedIn campaign operations: audiences, lists, sends, forms, ad accounts, testing, and reporting. The Content Manager owns the message and editorial calendar. Agree on campaign goals and timing together. Build useful campaign pages and forms, using gated content where it serves a clear purpose. Make sure event and website inquiries reach the right seller and receive timely follow-up. Support account-based campaigns aimed at named brands and agencies. Set up tracking and practical dashboards with Sales Operations. Check lead capture and follow-up weekly; report monthly on lead quality, sales conversations, qualified opportunities, and campaign spending. Use cost per lead as one measure, not the main definition of success. Explain the results and recommend what to improve. Test pages, offers, and campaigns. Do more of what works and stop what doesn’t. Meet with sellers regularly to hear what is working and fix what is not. Work with Content, Product Marketing, Design, Events, and PR on a shared campaign schedule. Partner with life360.com owners, developers, and Sales Operations on technical delivery. Make support needs and dependencies clear before committing to timelines. What We’re Looking For 5+ years in B2B demand gen, marketing operations, or digital marketing, with a track record of measurable lead and pipeline growth. Builder’s track record: you have set up lead scoring, routing, and nurture programs in HubSpot yourself, and you can show us. Hands-on HubSpot and Salesforce skills, including how data moves between them. Website ownership: you have managed a website and built landing pages, and you know how to brief and check the work of developers and agencies. SEO foundation: keyword strategy, on-page and technical SEO, site structure, and structured data, with results you can show. items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Chicago, Illinois, United States URL: https://careers.mheducation.com Overview Build the Future McGraw Hill’s Higher Education team delivers powerful platforms, highly personalized course materials, and effective learning supplements to help students achieve their goals at every stage of their academic and professional careers. How can you make an impact? This remote Inside, Customer Success Representative will support college-level faculty and administrators by providing guidance, training, and resources to help them successfully use our solutions. The role focuses on improving educational outcomes, student engagement, affordability, access, and equity while building strong customer relationships that drive loyalty and retention. The CSR will partner closely with Sales and other Customer Success team members to manage customer pipelines and track progress. This role will also focus on increasing digital product usage and supporting opportunities for customer growth. This is a remote role open to candidates residing ideally in the Eastern or Central Time Zone. Candidates should be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. There is a requirement for 5-10% travel throughout the year. What would you be doing? Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of McGraw Hill Higher Education’s digital products, including Connect and SIMnet, as well as foundational learning science and instructional design concepts. Utilize Salesforce and Gainsight to manage sales pipelines, track customer stages, measure pipeline velocity, and analyze customer data. Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to assess customer needs, develop implementation plans, and support retention and new business opportunities. Oversee implementation processes for new and returning customers, ensuring they are positioned to achieve improved outcomes and a positive experience. Conduct one-on-one and group Zoom meetings to provide consultative guidance, training, and support tailored to customer needs and goals. Provide timely follow-up and resolve customer issues through troubleshooting, research, and collaboration with internal teams, including Sales, Product, Implementation, and Technical Support. Participate in team meetings, strategy sessions, and professional development while sharing customer feedback and ideas to help improve products and services. We’re looking for someone with: Bachelor’s Degree. 1-2 years experience in customer success or similar role related to software implementation (higher education experience highly preferred). Exceptional communication and presentation skills to effectively train and support customers with varying levels of technical acumen and confidence. Ability to excel in a remote setting. This is primarily a work-from-home position that requires a high level of communication, organization, and attention to detail. Positive attitude, purpose-driven spirit, and growth mindset for embracing challenges. Instructional design, teaching and/or coaching experience also a plus. Experience using Salesforce and Gainsight is preferred. Why work for us? The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As the leading education partner for millions of educators, learners and professionals, we are expanding the possibilities of content and technology to make learning better in a connected world. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights. The pay range for this position is between $60,000 - $70,000 annually. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. Click here to learn more about our benefit offerings. McGraw Hill recruiters always use a “@mheducation.com” or "@careers.mheducation.com” email addresses and/or from our Applicant Tracking System, iCIMS. Any variation of this email domain should be considered suspicious. Additionally, McGraw Hill recruiters and authorized representatives will never request sensitive information in email. 51415 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mcgraw-hill-llc-customer-success-representative-inside

items.description: About the Role Wisevu and our sister agencies, Homevu.com and CharityMarketing.com, are building world-class digital marketing for the age of AI. Together, we serve clients across three of the most essential industries: healthcare/wellness, home services, and charities and nonprofits. This is an opportunity to become the creative force behind our marketing output. You will lead a talented team of writers and designers, transforming ideas, insights, and AI-assisted workflows into original, persuasive, conversion-focused marketing that drives real business results. You will bring the strategic thinking of a marketer, the instincts of a creative director, and the editorial eye needed to raise the quality bar across everything we produce. Your Mission: Own the creative vision, quality standards, and marketing effectiveness of content, design, and campaign deliverables across Wisevu, Homevu.com, and CharityMarketing.com. Lead the creative direction for websites, landing pages, paid advertising, social media, and other digital marketing assets. Guide writers and designers to create original, audience-focused, conversion-driven marketing. Strengthen messaging, offers, headlines, campaign concepts, and brand positioning to maximize marketing impact. Build creative standards and review processes that improve quality, consistency, and team performance. Mentor the creative team and champion the effective use of AI to enhance, not replace, human expertise. Collaborate with SEO, Paid Media, Strategy, and Project Management teams to achieve measurable business results. What Makes You a Great Fit: You have C1-level (Advanced) English proficiency. You hold a Bachelor’s degree or higher in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Media Studies, Brand Management, Journalism, or a related field. Experience working in digital marketing, advertising, or SEO agencies; 5+ years of experience in creative direction, branding, content, or digital marketing, supported by a strong portfolio. Experience leading and mentoring creative teams. Strong marketing judgment with the ability to create and evaluate high-performing copy and creative. Hands-on experience with websites, landing pages, Google Ads, paid social advertising, and conversion-focused marketing. How We Work: Fully remote position. Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM Eastern Time. Fully remote work with a globally distributed team. Starting salary between $3000-$4000 CAD/month, which will be negotiated during the interviews based on competencies, skills, and experience. Annual salary review. 30 paid leave days per year. Premium training programs and access to an internal knowledge base built across 18 years of hands-on experience. Professional equipment budget. Access to cutting-edge marketing and AI tools. Long-term stability with a company operating since 2008. We’re excited to see your work and hear your ideas, and work on exciting projects together. We kindly ask that you provide us with your resume in English. Wisevu Inc. 2026 © All the content in this job ad is the sole private property of Wisevu Inc. and shall not be used without written consent from Wisevu Inc. The content therein is protected by the Copyright Act of Canada and the Copyright Act of the United States of America. All Rights Reserved.

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.
